mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 2% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6%, the combination signals a loose monetary policy with economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: loose monetary policy with high unemployment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and UNRATE > 6%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over 6 months signals robust demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST rises > 10% in 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3%, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% over 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS declines > 2% in 3 months.
